Self-contained AI chat over a v6-compatible `/api/chat`: a streaming conversation with model/effort selectors, suggestions, attachments, per-message copy/regenerate, and human-in-the-loop tool approvals. The backend owns model selection and tool execution; the selected model, effort, approval policy and thread id are forwarded in the request body.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/Chat.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Chat } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
